Leaf word w (u32): when query+0x29 is set top = (w & 0x7fff) - ((w >> 15) & 0x7ff) - 0x4000 and tall = w >> 26, else top = (w & 0x7fff) - 0x4000 and tall = 0; top_y = top * 2 / 100 (m). The u16 tri indices follow, then one u32 quantised box per tri (x/z relative to the leaf box, +-127) tested against the query box; hits go as a bitmask to the query callback [query]. So H0 (low 15 bits) = 0x4000 + 50*maxY and must not be lower than the leaf's real top, and ground tris must be the first w+5 entries.

notes: 2026-11-17 engine-re track runtime round 2, static. Called once per XML <Volume> by Game_TrackSpace_LoadXml (0x1445ec55b) with the 2 gates x 4 points: slots 0..3 of gate 0 then gate 1, filled from point4, point3, point2, point1 in that order (parse at 0x1445ec6ed..0x1445ec9e0, store 0x1445ec5bd). When route+0xa0 is set (always 1 when LoadXml creates the 0xa8-byte route) and the distance between the two gates' (slot1 + 0.5*slot2) points is > 100 m, the gates are lerped into n = ceil(d/99.9) pieces (vroundss imm 0xa at 0x1445f2d9d; piece i uses t0 = i*s/d, t1 = min((i+1)*s, d)/d, s = d/n) and the function recurses (correction V10791). Volume +0x00 u8 = route byte route+0 (0 main, 1 pit), +0x01 u8 = strip index k, +0x04 u32 = own index, +0x134 f32 start distance = previous volume +0x134 + +0x138 (0 for the first), +0x138 f32 length = |+0xd0 - +0xc0| of strip 1; all three strips share start and length. So the car is inside the TrackSpace while it is anywhere between point1 and point4; point2/point3 only split the middle strip (index 1) from the two side strips (0 and 2). raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested)

name: Game_TrackSpaceVolume_BuildPlanes
proto: void Game_TrackSpaceVolume_BuildPlanes(TrackSpaceVolume *v, const vec4 *a, const vec4 *b, const vec4 *c, const vec4 *d)
notes: 2026-11-17 engine-re track runtime round 2, static. a,b = the two points of the far gate (gate 1, slots k and k+1), c,d = the near gate (gate 0, slots k+1 and k). Stores a,b,c,d at +0x20/+0x30/+0x40/+0x50, then makes 8 box corners: each point +3.0 m in y (top, 0x145bf1430) and -2.0 m in y (bottom, 0x145489b90). Six planes at +0x60..+0xb0 (16 bytes: unit normal xyz, w = dot(n, first point)), from corner triples: 0 = (top c, top d, bottom d) near gate edge, 1 = (top b, top a, bottom a) far gate edge, 2 = (top d, top a, bottom a) side through d-a, 3 = (top c, bottom c, bottom b) side through c-b, 4 = top plane (top b, top a, top d), 5 = bottom plane (bottom b, bottom a, bottom d). Each plane is flipped (normal and w negated) when the box centre would be on its positive side, so inside = dot(p,n) - w <= FLT_EPSILON for all tested planes (Game_TrackSpace_FindVolume tests [0x145faa5f4]+1 planes: 4 = planes 0..3 by default, 6 with use_tb_planes). So without use_tb_planes the volume is an open vertical prism (no height limit); with it the box spans 2 m below to 3 m above the XML points. +0xc0 = centre of the near gate edge (mid of bottom c and top d), +0xd0 = centre of the far gate edge (mid of top a and bottom b), +0xe0 / +0xf0 = centres of the two side edges, +0x100/+0x110 = AABB of the 8 corners (w 0), +0x120 = AABB half extents, +0x10 = mean of the 8 corners. raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-17 at user request (lane owner review requested)

name: Game_TrackSpaceGrid_AddVolumeToCell
notes: 2026-11-20 engine-re round L2 AI / track-markup size limits (static). Per-cell add of Game_TrackSpaceGrid_InsertVolume (6 call sites, all in 0x1445fb230). The cell holds a u16 index into the 32-byte cell-record vector g+0x30..+0x38 (cmp of the cell value against the record count at 0x1445fb7a2; 0xffff = empty cell). A new record is appended (growth 1.5x via allocator g+0x28) and its index is stored back into the cell as a u16 (mov word [rbx], r13w at 0x1445fb8f8). The volume index (u16, 3rd arg) is then appended to the record u16 list (+8..+0x10) unless already present (dup scan cmp word at 0x1445fb930). No count check anywhere: more than 65535 non-empty cells per route would truncate the record index (record 0xffff reads as empty), and volume indices above 65535 wrap. Volumes = 3 strips per XML TSD volume piece of <= 99.9 m (Game_TrackSpace_AddVolumeFromGates), so the u16 limit is about 21845 XML-volume pieces per route - far above any real track (Nordschleife ~20.8 km with 7-220 m sections stays below ~1000 pieces). raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-20 at user request (lane owner review requested)
